title: asplenium obovatum var. numidicum
intro:
Asplenium obovatum var. numidicum, commonly known as the Numidian maiden's hair fern, is a rare and endemic species of fern native to the island of Elba and North Africa.

This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its ant-inflammatory and anti-asthmatic properties. The therapeutic actions of Asplenium obovatum var. numidicum include the stimulation of the nervous system and the promotion of diuresis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
